title.zh: 【Bitdeer：马来西亚新山 AI 设施已签约超 17 亿美元五年期合同】
title.en: 【Bitdeer：马来西亚新山 AI 设施已签约超 17 亿美元五年期合同】

current_state.zh: Bitdeer reported that over 70% of its 21.7 MW A201 AI facility in Johor Bahru, Malaysia is under contract for more than $1.7B in five-year revenue, raising its total backlog to roughly $2.9B, and that it has purchased over 100 racks of NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 liquid-cooling systems.
